name: Rolling Forcing
provider: self-hosted (Nanyang Technological University, Tencent ARC Lab)
model_version: Rolling Forcing rolling_forcing_dmd.pt (generator_ema; rolling-window joint denoising over 5 blocks of 3 latents, 5-step DMD, attention sink, no CFG) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code TencentARC/RollingForcing@a1477d09e85d

weights.repo: TencentARC/RollingForcing@20edee70 (checkpoints/rolling_forcing_dmd.pt) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps. Upstream rolling forcing: a window of 5 blocks (3 latents = 12 frames each) at staggered noise levels (warped 1000/800/600/400/200, shift 5.0) is denoised by one DiT call per window; the oldest block is then final and is decoded and sent live, so one block of 12 frames per window (the first output after 5 start-up windows). Long sessions use upstream's rolling clean KV cache with the first block kept as an attention-sink anchor; the temporal RoPE table is extended from 1024 to 4096 positions with the same formula. It has no prompt-switch mechanism: the block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' is re-encoded and the cross-attention cache reset at the next window, so it conditions the remaining steps of the 5 blocks in flight; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input.
